title: upstream: OpenMLS checks only part of mls-ext §4.7
description: OpenMLS 0.9.1 AppDataUpdate commit validation implements only part of draft-ietf-mls-extensions-10 §4.7 (a component gets either a single remove of existing data, or one or more updates). mimi-mls re-checks every rule in member.rs resolve_app_data_updates (found in mimid-1wgh.4.3). Needs a minimal repro listing exactly which rules OpenMLS misses before reporting. Report upstream only with Mark's explicit per-action OK.
